title: Output Depends Only on Core Configuration Data
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $c,d$ be configurations on that input. If their states, input-head positions, work-tape contents, and work-tape head positions agree, then the optional symbol emitted by one step of $M$ from $c$ equals the optional symbol emitted from $d$.
